# Skill Launcher Cloud - agent guide

A static page with no server: it edits two private GitHub repos through the GitHub API, with one token
kept in the user's browser. An agent does not click this page. Use the repos directly (git or the gh CLI).

## The two repos (user 2026-11-04)
- Zoobot123/manga-skills   the NovelAI skills only (NovelAI pictures, manga, NovelAI text). Entry point: library/novelai-claude/SKILL.md.
- Zoobot123/claude-skills  every other skill (ComfyUI, Anima, MiniMax, search, game, Blender, agents ...).
  Exception: phone-nai and phone-manga stay in claude-skills, because the phone loads them from ~/claude-skills.

## Quick start
```
gh api repos/Zoobot123/manga-skills/git/trees/main?recursive=1
gh api repos/Zoobot123/claude-skills/git/trees/main?recursive=1
gh api repos/Zoobot123/<repo>/contents/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md
```

## Layout (the same in both repos)
- skills/<name>/    loaded skills (skills/README.md lists them).
- library/<name>/   stored skills, never loaded (library/README.md in claude-skills; skills/README.md in manga-skills).
- <name>/launcher.json   the skill's form: jobs, fields, prompt tail.
- <name>/reference/tag_filter.txt, tag_filter_negative.txt   optional: the skill then gets a Filter tab. Tags that never reach NovelAI, one per line.
- .skill-launcher/families.json   the user's category choices {skill: family}.
- .skill-launcher/stock.json      dropdown lists, written by the PC sync (manga-skills).
- .skill-launcher/pending.json    manga-skills only. Moves and removals done in the cloud, for the PC Skill Launcher sync:
  [{op: trash|move|repo, skill, to, area?, at}]. op "repo" = the folder <area>/<skill>/ went to the repo in "to".
  The next PC sync applies and clears them.

## How the PC takes a cloud change
- manga-skills: the PC Skill Launcher sync. Moving or removing a skill must also add a pending.json entry, or the sync puts it back.
- claude-skills: skills-sync (git pull with rebase, PC and phone). git applies moves and removals by itself; no pending.json.

## Rules
- A NovelAI skill goes in manga-skills; any other skill goes in claude-skills. To move one, move the whole folder
  (same skills/ or library/ place), remove it from the old repo, and add the pending.json entry when the old repo is manga-skills.
- Trigger phrases live in the SKILL.md description: "Trigger on 'a', 'b'. Not for: c."
- Removing a skill needs the user's yes. Never commit a key or token. Every cast field says "Name, 18+ version".
- With the PC on, use Skill Launcher instead: http://127.0.0.1:4340/llms.txt
